in_sanskrit.name: धिरु
in_sanskrit.meaning: धिर: धिरता सततं ध्यायति । धिर: धिरस्य स्थितिः । धिर: धिरात्मा, धिरा बुद्धिः ।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who meditates constantly (धिर: धिरता) or one who is steadfast (धिर: धिरस्य स्थितिः) or one who is wise and intelligent (धिर: धिरात्मा, धिरा बुद्धिः).

in_hindi.name: धिरू
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who remains steadfast (धिर: धिरता रहता) or one who is determined.

in_tamil.name: திரு
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is steady and resolute.

in_telugu.name: ధిరు
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is steadfast or resolute.

in_marathi.name: Dhiru
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intention, Attention, Focus
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhiru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhiru is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhirah' which means 'intention, attention, focus'. It is a name given to those who are wise and focused in their actions and thoughts.

in_bengali.name: Dhiru
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Intention, Attention, Focus
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhiru একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dhiru is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhirah' which means 'intention, attention, focus'. It is a name given to those who are wise and focused in their actions and thoughts.
